learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn all about fun action words that show what we are doing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Verbs are doing words or action words. They tell us what a person animal or thing is doing.
Words like run jump play eat and sleep are all verbs because they are actions we can do with our body.

fun_activity.title: 🎶 Simon Says Actions
fun_activity.instructions: Ask an elder to play Simon Says. When they say Simon says jump you must do the jump action word!

quick_recap: ⭐ Verbs are also called action words.
⭐ Any work or action we do is a verb.
⭐ Jump sing and dance are fun verbs.
